title: Bulb Hanging Lights
body:
"Hanging lightbulbs on a wire. I wonder how they got so many of them?"


Description

Bulb Hanging Lights are a similar item to the Hanging Pennants, but they are bulbs and glow!

You can buy it at Illumine Designs for $450.

The placing system is the same as any other item that depends on some kind of wire.
